Then the inbox deduplicates it and the match is written once

  Scenario: AC13 Activity retry and timeout write once (X4, BR9)
    Given the rwb-treatment contract fake does not answer inside 2 s when the matchPayments activity reads the settlement treatment
    When the activity times out, is retried on the workflow's own backoff and the retry is answered
    Then one proceeds row with matched_to SETTLEMENT, one decision record and one ProceedsMatched event keyed by caseId are written, and no second write occurs
    Then if the retries end without an answer, nothing is written and no event is published
